representative_sentences.sentence: The blanket was tucked around her as if pressed carefully there by someone else.
Once they had it blown up, he pulled the blanket out and spread it over the mattress before they sat down on it.
Waiting for him to come out of the bathroom she pulled the light blanket over herself more to cover her bare legs than because she was cold.
She sat up, groggy from sleep, the blanket falling to her waist. ‘
He had laid his coat down on one side and she knew it was there for a buffer between her skin and the velour-covered plastic of the mattress.
She snuggled down onto his coat pretending to herself that the scent of him was not having an impact on her emotions or physical comfort.
His jacket, she realised, was still on the ground from where he had folded it to put under her head. ‘
He shook out the comforter and sailed it over the top sheet, straightening it when it settled.
The insulation on the wire had been nibbled. “
